import sys
sys.path.append('/path/to/tools')
from tools import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_restaurants, filter_restaurants, search_nearest, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Search for flights (non-stop from Atlanta to Las Vegas, return dates May 17-27, 2025)
flights_search = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="Las Vegas",
    departure_date=["May 17, 2025"],
    arrival_date=["May 27, 2025"],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save flight search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights_search", value=flights_search)

# Filter flights to find non-stop options (num_layovers=0)
filtered_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=flights_search,
    num_layovers=[0]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_flights", value=filtered_flights)

# Search for hotels in Las Vegas with pool and wifi amenities
hotels_search = search_hotels(
    city="Las Vegas",
    checkin_date=["May 17, 2025"],
    checkout_date=["May 27, 2025"],
    pool_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_search", value=hotels_search)

# Filter hotels to find those with 3.5+ rating
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_search,
    rating=[3.5, 5.0]
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

print("No planning needed")
